question: Chirag Chandrashekhar Shetty is related to _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Badminton**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Chirag Chandrashekhar Shetty is a prominent Indian badminton player specializing in men's doubles.
 
• He has achieved significant success in international tournaments, often partnering with Satwiksairaj Rankireddy.
 
• Chirag Shetty and his partner have won prestigious titles, including the Thailand Open and the Commonwealth Games.
 
• They have been consistently ranked among the top badminton doubles pairs in the world by the Badminton World Federation (BWF).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Badminton**

 
 
• Badminton is a popular racquet sport played using racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net.
 
• The game can be played in singles (one player per side) and doubles (two players per side) formats.
 
• It is an Olympic sport with five events: men's singles, women's singles, men's doubles, women's doubles, and mixed doubles.
 
• The Badminton World Federation (BWF) is the international governing body for the sport, overseeing international competitions and the world rankings.
 
• Badminton requires a combination of agility, speed, and precision, with players often covering significant distances on the court during a match.
 
 
 
• **Chirag Chandrashekhar Shetty**
 
 
• Born on July 4, 1997, Chirag Shetty has emerged as one of India's top badminton doubles players.
 
• He, along with his partner Satwiksairaj Rankireddy, has made history by winning multiple international titles.
 
• Chirag Shetty's achievements have contributed significantly to the growing popularity of badminton in India.
 
• He has represented India in various prestigious tournaments, including the Commonwealth Games and the BWF World Championships.
 
 
 
• **International Tournaments**
 
 
• Major international tournaments in badminton include the All England Open, BWF World Championships, and the Thomas & Uber Cup.
 
• Players earn points from these tournaments, which contribute to their world rankings.
 
• The Olympic Games is one of the most prestigious events for badminton players, held every four years.
 
• Winning these tournaments often requires a high level of skill, strategy, and physical fitness.
